candidate_A.name: UNIFIED_REDUCED_CONTEXT_PEFT

selection_rationale: Candidate A at 768 is blocked because matched-context QLoRA failed the unchanged 1536 MiB headroom gate.
Candidate B is blocked because QLoRA at 1024 failed the unchanged 1536 MiB headroom gate.
Candidate A at 512 passed Q1 and exact Q2 for both LoRA and QLoRA.
The 512 exposure loss is material but retains a majority of the 1024 assistant and final-answer signal; it is accepted only after the higher-context paths failed.
Candidate C remains NOT_RUN because a higher-value bounded path already qualified.
